Question 1
?

Which of the following is NOT a first-order linear ordinary differential equation?

a
ydydx+x=y
b
dydx+y=xy
c
dydx+y=x
d
dydx+y=cos⁡earctan⁡(x2+ln⁡x)
e
dydx+x=y
